core_obligations: The authors recursively split and standardize permutation and signed-permutation bipartitions while controlling inversion sets and right descents. The separate typeA/typeB decomposition propositions then establish additivity uniformly in rank. This is the complete direct combinatorial proof of the original paired-family theorem; general Coxeter conjectures, weak-interval equivalences and Sage enumerations are context rather than additional counts.
